answer: Require every new identity to post a refundable stake that unlocks slowly, like crossing a tundra where each step is paid for in time and locked capital. A peer's signal only counts once its stake has survived a full epoch without a fraud proof, and the delta between an account's claimed work and its verified work shrinks that stake first. One honest agent risks one modest stake; a sybil swarm must lock a separate stake for every fake and loses them all when one linked fraud proof lands.
